notes: The decorrelated band was drawn from the NISAR valid mask (median LOS on 3 km blocks). USGS range offsets on the same NISAR pair (p040) read about 2 m toward the satellite on the Tonosi side, two to three times our phase-based +60-170 cm, so the north-side facts say the phase values may undercount. Our sign is positive = toward the satellite, as in the USGS files with their sign flipped.

facts.title: A landslide-scarred band where the radar lost the ground
facts.text: South of the Azuero-Soná fault rupture, a band from the south-west corner of the frame to the coast between Búcaro and Isla Cañas is decorrelated: coherence averages 0.2 and only about 7% of it is measured. The University of Panama's Institute of Geosciences counted 4,822 landslides in the epicentral zone.
facts.source: NISAR analysis | Instituto de Geociencias, Universidad de Panamá, via https://uphacialaluz.com/2026/10/29/instituto-de-geociencias-de-la-universidad-de-panama-identifica-9553-deslizamientos-asociados-al-terremoto-de-azuero/

facts.title: The hills NW of Tonosí moved over a metre
facts.text: North of the rupture, the hills north-west of Tonosí moved about 1.3 m toward the satellite on average, up to about 1.7 m: the largest motion in any of our scenes. USGS range offsets on the same NISAR pair read about 2 m here, so the phase-based values may undercount.
facts.source: NISAR analysis | USGS finite-fault model us6000u18k (NISAR range offsets) https://earthquake.usgs.gov/product/finite-fault/us6000u18k_1/us/1792710177789/

facts.title: Tonosí moved ~60 cm, but few buildings fell
facts.text: The Tonosí plain moved about 64 cm toward the satellite (45 to 86 cm). The town's hotel collapsed and patients were treated in tents, but Copernicus EMS found only 3 of 958 buildings damaged in its post-quake satellite images.
facts.source: NISAR analysis | Copernicus EMS EMSR934 AOI05 https://rapidmapping.emergency.copernicus.eu/backend/EMSR934/AOI05/GRA_PRODUCT/EMSR934_AOI05_GRA_PRODUCT_v1.zip

facts.title: At Búcaro the ground broke 1 m up and 1 m sideways
facts.text: Field geologist Isaac Guerra Araúz measured 1-1.2 m of horizontal and about 1 m of vertical surface rupture at Búcaro (preliminary). On Búcaro's longitude NISAR's motion drops by about 60 cm across the decorrelated band, from about +80 cm at 7.42°N to +17 cm at the coast.
facts.source: NISAR analysis | La Estrella de Panamá https://www.laestrella.com.pa/vida-y-cultura/ciencia/cientifico-chiricano-estudia-las-rupturas-que-dejo-el-sismo-AH26746251

facts.title: Isla Cañas sank 15-30 cm and was cut in two
facts.text: Isla Cañas sank 15-30 cm and the sea cut a channel through it, splitting the island in two (preliminary field figures). NISAR has no measurement here: none of the island's pixels stayed coherent between the passes.

facts.title: Across the fault, the Cambutal coast moved far less
facts.text: South of the rupture, along the coast past Cambutal, NISAR sees about +18 cm (12 to 25 cm): a fraction of the metre-plus on the north side.
